roadmap.title: Assisted 100% campaign run
roadmap.description: Explore every chapter on Assisted. Buy each regional treasure map, finish all 19 Merchant requests, destroy all 16 Clockwork Castellans, clear every shooting-range course, and complete every chapter-specific challenge. Keep a manual save at the final Chapter 16 Merchant.

roadmap.title: Assisted NG+ restriction run
roadmap.description: Prepare upgraded handguns, knives, body armor, ammunition, and storage on the Chapter 16 save, then start Assisted NG+. Finish under eight hours while using no recovery items, only knives and handguns, and never speaking to the Merchant.

roadmap.title: Fresh Professional S+ campaign
roadmap.description: Start a fresh Professional New Game and finish under 5:30 with no more than 15 saves. This stacks all six campaign difficulty and rank achievements; afterward, place every remaining bonus and purchased weapon in the inventory for Gun Fanatic.

roadmap.title: Separate Ways first run
roadmap.description: Complete Separate Ways on Assisted, gather treasures and Spinels for preparation, and keep a manual save at the final Merchant.

roadmap.title: Fresh Separate Ways Professional S+
roadmap.description: Start a fresh Professional New Game and finish under 2:30 with no more than 10 saves. Bonus weapons are allowed, and the result stacks every Separate Ways difficulty achievement.

achievements.description: Parry an enemy with a knife.
achievements.summary: Parry one enemy attack with a @item{knife}.

guide.context: Assisted difficulty keeps the parry indicator visible longer, making the opening chapters the easiest place to learn the timing.

steps.text: Equip any knife, face an attacking enemy, and press the displayed @mechanic{Parry} input just before the strike connects.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon.
achievements.summary: Pay the @npc{Merchant} to upgrade any weapon statistic once.

guide.context: The first purchasable improvement is enough; no weapon needs to reach maximum level.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Tune Up} at any Merchant, select a weapon and statistic, then buy one upgrade with ptas.

achievements.description: Get the exclusive upgrade for a weapon.
achievements.summary: Apply one @mechanic{Exclusive Upgrade} to any weapon.

guide.context: An exclusive becomes purchasable after all ordinary statistics are maximized; a Castle Exclusive Upgrade Ticket bypasses that prerequisite.

steps.text: Fully upgrade one weapon and buy its Exclusive Upgrade, or trade 30 Spinels for an @item{Exclusive Upgrade Ticket} after reaching the Castle and apply it to any weapon.

achievements.description: Complete a request for the Merchant.
achievements.summary: Finish any one @npc{Merchant request} and claim its completion.

guide.context: Requests remain available only until their region closes, so the Chapter 1 blue-medallion notice is the earliest safe option.

steps.text: Read a blue request notice, satisfy its displayed objective, and speak to the Merchant before leaving the region so the request appears as complete.

achievements.description: Rescue Ashley as she's being carried away by the enemy.
achievements.summary: Shoot an enemy carrying @npc{Ashley} until the enemy drops her.

guide.context: The first reliable opportunities begin in Chapter 5; a leg shot stops the carrier while reducing the risk of hitting Ashley.

steps.text: Allow an enemy to lift Ashley and start carrying her toward an exit, then shoot the carrier’s leg before Ashley is taken away.

achievements.description: Destroy a Clockwork Castellan.
achievements.summary: Destroy any one of the @item{16 Clockwork Castellans}.

guide.context: Each chapter contains one Castellan, and destroyed figures remain recorded across saves and playthroughs.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, enter the central house after meeting dynamite throwers, look through the damaged roof, and shoot the small ticking Castellan.

achievements.description: Defeat Del Lago.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Del Lago} with harpoons in the Chapter 3 lake battle.

guide.context: The boat supplies unlimited harpoons, so no inventory preparation is needed.

steps.text: Follow the mandatory Chapter 3 lake route, dodge floating obstacles, and keep striking Del Lago with harpoons until the boss dies.

achievements.description: Defeat Bitores Mendez.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Bitores Mendez} at the end of Chapter 6.

guide.context: This mandatory boss separates the Village and Castle regions; finish regional collectibles before entering the fight.

steps.text: Damage Mendez through both phases of the slaughterhouse battle until the Chapter 6 boss is defeated.

achievements.description: Defeat the Verdugo.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Verdugo} in Chapter 10 before boarding the elevator.

guide.context: Surviving until the elevator arrives is enough for story progress but does not award this achievement; the boss must die.

steps.text: Remain in the Chapter 10 arena and keep attacking Verdugo until the boss dies; board the elevator only after the kill awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Defeat Ramón Salazar.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Ramón Salazar} in the Chapter 12 boss fight.

guide.context: A Golden Chicken Egg deals extreme damage to Salazar if saved for this encounter.

steps.text: Attack Salazar whenever the exposed body emerges from the creature’s mouth and finish the mandatory Chapter 12 battle.

achievements.displayName: You Used to Be a Good Guy
achievements.description: Defeat Jack Krauser.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Jack Krauser} in the Chapter 14 ruins battle.

guide.context: Keep a durable knife for the mandatory close-quarters portions of the encounter.

steps.text: Complete every phase of the Chapter 14 Krauser fight and deliver the final blow.

achievements.description: Defeat Osmund Saddler.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Osmund Saddler} in the Chapter 16 finale.

guide.context: The special red rocket launcher supplied during the last phase is permitted for every restriction-run achievement.

steps.text: Destroy Saddler’s exposed eyes, survive the collapsing-arena phase, then use the supplied @item{Special Rocket Launcher} to finish the fight.

achievements.description: Defeat 3 enemies at once with a flash grenade.
achievements.summary: Kill at least @item{3 enemies} with one @item{Flash Grenade}.

guide.context: A Flash Grenade instantly kills crows and exposed Plaga, so ordinary firearm damage is unnecessary.

steps.text: At the Chapter 3 quarry, approach the large crow flock without scattering it and throw one Flash Grenade into the center so at least three crows die together.

achievements.description: Defeat a Garrador using only knives.
achievements.summary: Kill the lone Chapter 7 @enemy{Garrador} using only knives.

guide.context: Any firearm, grenade, or environmental damage invalidates the attempt; Assisted reduces the number of back stabs required.

steps.text: Save before the prison encounter, crouch so the blind Garrador cannot track footsteps, circle behind it, and repeatedly stab the exposed back parasite with knives until it dies.

achievements.description: Kill 2 parasites inside a Regenerador with a single bullet.
achievements.summary: Destroy @item{2 parasites} inside one @enemy{Regenerador} with a single bullet.

guide.context: The dormant Regeneradors in the Chapter 13 Incubation Lab let you inspect several parasite layouts before waking an enemy.

steps.text: Collect the @item{Biosensor Scope} beside the keycard machine and mount it on a rifle.
Scan the Regeneradors still inside their pods, move around one until two parasites overlap in the scope, then fire one penetrating rifle bullet through both.

achievements.description: Throw a grenade into Ramón Salazar's mouth.
achievements.summary: During Chapter 12, land a grenade inside @enemy{Ramón Salazar’s open mouth}.

guide.context: Salazar moves frequently, so a manual save before the boss room protects the one-time opportunity.

steps.text: Equip a Hand Grenade as the battle begins, wait until Salazar’s body is visible inside the open mouth, and throw the grenade directly into that opening.

achievements.description: Use a cannon to defeat a zealot.
achievements.summary: Kill one Castle @enemy{zealot} with a @mechanic{cannon}.

guide.context: Chapter 7 provides zealots on the approach to the raised cannon; Chapter 8 offers another group beside the gate.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, raise and load the cannon, aim at an approaching zealot rather than only the gate, and fire until the enemy is killed.

achievements.description: Make it through both minecart sections in the underground tunnel without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Finish both Chapter 11 @mechanic{minecart rides} without the cart taking damage.

guide.context: Damage during either ride voids the attempt, but a manual save before boarding allows a quick retry.

steps.text: Shoot crossbow users, dynamite, and approaching carts before their attacks land; shoot the chainsaw enemy’s head when he closes in.
Lean opposite each dangerous turn when Luis calls it out, then complete the second ride with the cart’s health untouched.

achievements.description: Reach the top of the clock tower without the lift stopping once.
achievements.summary: Ride the Chapter 12 @mechanic{clock-tower lift} to the top without letting it stop.

guide.context: The lift stops only when too many zealots remain aboard, so kill boarders immediately.

steps.text: Reload from the save before the lift if necessary, use a fast high-damage weapon to shoot every zealot as it jumps aboard, and reach the top without the platform pausing.

achievements.description: Escape on the water scooter without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Finish the Chapter 16 @mechanic{water-scooter escape} without vehicle damage.

guide.context: Assisted provides more escape time, allowing careful steering instead of risky corner cutting.

steps.text: Save before mounting the scooter, avoid walls and solid debris through the entire tunnel, and reach the final jump with the scooter undamaged.

achievements.description: Sell a single treasure for at least 100000 ptas.
achievements.summary: Sell one jeweled treasure to the @npc{Merchant} for at least @item{100,000 ptas}.

guide.context: The Elegant Crown found on the Chapter 10 route toward Verdugo has five sockets and reaches the threshold with a five-color bonus.

steps.text: Inlay the @item{Elegant Crown} with a Sapphire, Yellow Diamond, Emerald, Alexandrite, and Red Beryl.
Sell the completed crown to any Merchant once its displayed value is at least 100,000 ptas.

achievements.description: Obtain all treasures indicated on the village treasure map in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{39 Village-map treasures} before leaving Chapter 6.

guide.context: All 39 must be obtained in one playthrough; treasure progress does not combine across runs.

steps.text: At the Chapter 2 Merchant, trade for the @item{Village Treasure Map}; clear every marked icon, including Small Key drawers and lake sites reached by boat.
Before entering the Mendez fight and leaving for the Castle, open the map at each zoom level and confirm no Village treasure icon remains.

achievements.description: Obtain all treasures indicated on the castle treasure map in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{41 Castle-map treasures} before finishing Chapter 12.

guide.context: Ashley’s Chapter 9 section and several Cubic Device containers create the most easily missed Castle treasures.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Castle Treasure Map} in Chapter 7, retain the Cubic Device, and backtrack for every square lock box before the Chapter 12 gondola.

During Ashley’s Chapter 9 section, collect the @item{Bunch of Keys} before solving the clock and use its three keys to claim all three matching treasures before leaving her section; also collect the treasure requiring Leon and Ashley before placing the statue heads.
Confirm every Castle icon is cleared before riding the clock-tower gondola and fighting Salazar.

achievements.description: Obtain all treasures indicated on the island treasure map in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{24 Island-map treasures} before the Chapter 16 escape.

guide.context: The Island has no later free roam, and several elevators or chapter endings permanently close earlier rooms.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Island Treasure Map} at the start of Chapter 13 and clear every marked icon before each one-way door or elevator.
Perform a final full-map check in Chapter 16 before the Saddler fight and timed escape.

achievements.description: Obtain all weapons.
achievements.summary: Place every main-game weapon required by @mechanic{Gun Fanatic} in Leon’s inventory, including the @item{Primal Knife, Chicago Sweeper, Handcannon, and Infinite Rocket Launcher}.

guide.context: Weapons can be sold after registration; bonus weapons sitting only in typewriter storage do not count until moved into the attaché case.

steps.text: Acquire the field and Merchant weapons: Combat Knife, Fighting Knife, SG-09 R, Punisher, Red9, Blacktail, Matilda, W-870, Riot Gun, Striker, SR M1903, Stingray, CQBR Assault Rifle, Broken Butterfly, Killer7, TMP, LE 5, Bolt Thrower, and Rocket Launcher.

Unlock and withdraw @item{Primal Knife} after all Castellans, @item{Chicago Sweeper} after a sub-seven-hour Professional A rank, and @item{Handcannon} through its challenge or Mercenaries route; during NG+, spend 2,000,000 ptas on the @item{Infinite Rocket Launcher}.
Check @mechanic{Challenges → Gun Fanatic}; move every missing bonus weapon from storage into the attaché case until the counter completes.

achievements.description: Complete all requests from the Merchant.
achievements.summary: Complete all @item{19 Merchant requests} in one playthrough.

guide.context: Read each blue notice and turn in every completed request before its region closes; request progress resets on a new playthrough.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions
collectibles.method: Take the notice before the closed gate and destroy all five marked medallions.

collectibles.name: Pest Control
collectibles.method: Kill the three rats in the parry-tutorial rooms and ruined hallway.

collectibles.name: Viper Hunter
collectibles.method: Collect and sell three Vipers; the Fish Farm contains several.

collectibles.name: Grave Robber
collectibles.method: Shoot the V-shaped emblems on the matching double grave.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions 2
collectibles.method: Destroy every medallion marked around the Quarry and Fish Farm.

collectibles.name: Egg Hunt
collectibles.method: Collect the Golden Chicken Egg and sell it.

collectibles.name: Catch Me a Big Fish
collectibles.method: Harpoon the Lunker Bass and sell it.

collectibles.name: A Savage Mutt
collectibles.method: Explore the manor attic to spawn the target, then kill it in the Village.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions 3
collectibles.method: Destroy all medallions around the Castle entrance.

collectibles.name: Jewel Thief
collectibles.method: Shoot the crow nest above the gate, collect the Scratched Emerald, and sell it.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions 4
collectibles.method: Destroy all marked medallions around the Grand Hall.

collectibles.name: More Pest Control
collectibles.method: Kill the Dining Hall rat, armory-exit rat, and Chapter 10 corridor rat.

collectibles.name: Merciless Knight
collectibles.method: Return to Ashley’s Mausoleum and defeat the armored knight target.

collectibles.name: Insect Hive
collectibles.method: Shoot all four glowing hive entrances on the central ceiling mass.

collectibles.name: The Disgrace of the Salazar Family
collectibles.method: Throw an egg at Salazar’s portrait above the two red chairs.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions 5
collectibles.method: Destroy all marked medallions in the Cargo Depot.

collectibles.name: Even More Pest Control
collectibles.method: Kill all four rats before leaving Waste Disposal.

collectibles.name: The Wandering Dead
collectibles.method: Return before the Amber Storeroom lift and kill the marked powerful Regenerador.

collectibles.name: Destroy the Blue Medallions 6
collectibles.method: Destroy all marked medallions before passing the exit door.

achievements.description: Destroy all Clockwork Castellans.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{16 Clockwork Castellans}, one in each chapter.

guide.context: Destroyed Castellans persist across saves and playthroughs; the Challenges menu shows chapter completion, and the reward unlocks the Primal Knife for purchase in the Extra Content Shop.

collectibles.name: Chapter 1 Castellan
collectibles.method: Shoot through the damaged roof.

collectibles.name: Chapter 2 Castellan
collectibles.location: @loc{Hut left of the stairs after using the Hexagonal Emblem}
collectibles.method: Look above inside the hut.

collectibles.name: Chapter 3 Castellan
collectibles.method: Climb down the ladder, walk to the pier end, and look between the roof and crates.

collectibles.name: Chapter 4 Castellan
collectibles.method: Unlock the Insignia gate, climb the ladder, and shoot through the fence.

collectibles.name: Chapter 5 Castellan
collectibles.method: Pull the lever, boost Ashley up, and break the crate blocking the left side.

collectibles.name: Chapter 6 Castellan
collectibles.method: Look right beneath the bonfire.

collectibles.name: Chapter 7 Castellan
collectibles.method: Look on top of a shelf.

collectibles.name: Chapter 8 Castellan
collectibles.method: Drop from the right side, climb the tower, and circle the roof.

collectibles.name: Chapter 9 Castellan
collectibles.method: Search the northwest corner.

collectibles.name: Chapter 10 Castellan
collectibles.method: Look behind the bars for the upside-down figure.

collectibles.name: Chapter 11 Castellan
collectibles.method: Shoot the figure on the building wall before boarding the second cart.

collectibles.name: Chapter 12 Castellan
collectibles.method: Before going upstairs, break the figure resting on a crate at the ground floor’s northwest edge.

collectibles.name: Chapter 13 Castellan
collectibles.method: Take the right path and look between the green forklift and orange truck.

collectibles.name: Chapter 14 Castellan
collectibles.method: After Amber Storeroom, follow the tunnel south and look on the lockers to the right.

collectibles.name: Chapter 15 Castellan
collectibles.method: Look on the wooden beams above the treasure chest.

collectibles.name: Chapter 16 Castellan
collectibles.location: @loc{Rectangular enemy room during the timed escape}
collectibles.method: Shoot the figure on the right side before continuing.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Standard mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on @mechanic{Standard difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: A fresh Professional S+ clear awards this together with every higher campaign-difficulty achievement.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 16 on Standard, Hardcore, or Professional difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Standard mode with an S+ rank.
achievements.summary: Finish a fresh campaign with @mechanic{Standard S+} or earn @mechanic{Professional S+}.

guide.context: Standard S+ requires a fresh New Game under five hours; New Game+ cannot earn S+.

steps.text: Start a fresh Standard New Game and finish under 5:00, or complete the Professional S+ route described for Peerless Agent.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Hardcore mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on @mechanic{Hardcore difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Professional completion stacks with Hardcore and Standard completion achievements.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 16 on Hardcore or Professional difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Hardcore mode with an S+ rank.
achievements.summary: Finish a fresh campaign with @mechanic{Hardcore S+} or earn @mechanic{Professional S+}.

guide.context: Hardcore S+ requires a fresh New Game under 5:30. A Hardcore S+ result does not award Standard S+, but Professional S+ awards both.

steps.text: Start a fresh Hardcore New Game and finish under 5:30, or complete the fresh Professional S+ route.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Professional mode.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on @mechanic{Professional difficulty}.

guide.context: Professional unlocks after one campaign completion. A Professional S+ route can consolidate all six campaign difficulty achievements.

steps.text: Start a fresh Professional New Game, finish under 5:30 with no more than 15 saves, and quit to the main menu before reloading after any death so failed time is not retained.

Use manual saves before the Fish Farm, El Gigante, cabin, Mendez, Water Hall, maze, Ashley section, Chapter 10 combat rooms, Verdugo, Chapter 11, after minecarts, Salazar, Chapter 14 reunion, Krauser, and Chapter 15.

achievements.description: Complete the main story within 8 hours.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story in under @mechanic{8 hours}.

guide.context: Pausing in menus may still leave little route margin, while any campaign S+ run automatically beats this limit.

steps.text: Use the Assisted NG+ restriction run or a fresh S+ run, skip optional fights and cutscenes, and finish the Chapter 16 escape before the results timer reaches 8:00.

achievements.description: Complete the main story without using a recovery item.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story without using any @item{recovery item}.

guide.context: Assisted NG+ provides passive recovery from critical health, while fully repaired body armor absorbs damage without counting as healing.

steps.text: Before NG+, upgrade armor and prepare weapons and ammunition; once the run starts, never consume herbs, sprays, fish, eggs, or vipers.
Check @mechanic{Challenges → Frugalist} throughout the run and keep its invalid-action counter at zero until Chapter 16 ends.

achievements.description: Complete the main story using only knives and handguns. (Excluding specific battles.)
achievements.summary: Finish using only @item{handguns and knives}; Del Lago harpoons, Castle cannons, sentries, the wrecking ball, explosive barrels, range weapons, and the red story rocket are allowed, but grenades and eggs are forbidden.

guide.context: The in-game Challenges menu records disallowed Minimalist actions during the run, so its counter can reveal a voided attempt before the ending.

steps.text: Prepare upgraded handguns and durable knives before starting Assisted NG+, then store every other weapon and throwable.
Use only handguns and knives in combat, relying on the listed story and environmental weapons only where the campaign requires them, and reach the ending without throwing a grenade or egg.

achievements.description: Complete the main story without talking to the Merchant once.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story without speaking to the @npc{Merchant}.

guide.context: Merchant requests may be performed, but opening any shop conversation invalidates the run. All preparation must be completed before NG+ begins.

steps.text: On the Chapter 16 completion save, fully upgrade the handguns, knives, and armor needed for NG+, stock resources, then finish the campaign and start Assisted NG+.
Walk past every Merchant without interacting and confirm @mechanic{Challenges → Silent Stranger} remains valid until the final results screen.

achievements.description: Complete a game at the shooting range.
achievements.summary: Complete any one @mechanic{shooting-range course}.

guide.context: The first range opens beside the Merchant near the Chapter 3 lake; rank does not matter for this achievement.

steps.text: Enter the shooting range, choose any available course, and play through its results screen.

achievements.description: Earn an S rank in all games at the shooting range.
achievements.summary: Earn an @mechanic{S rank} in all @item{12 shooting-range courses}.

guide.context: All earlier courses remain selectable at the Chapter 14 and 15 range, so the entire set can be cleaned up in one late-game session.

steps.text: Reach the Chapter 14 or 15 shooting range and obtain S rank in courses 1-A through 4-C.
Prioritize sailor targets, avoid skull-marked penalties, and trigger each bonus round; a perfect score is unnecessary once the S threshold is reached.

achievements.description: Shoot through and destroy 5 targets at the shooting range with a single shot.
achievements.summary: Destroy @item{5 shooting-range targets} with one penetrating bullet.

guide.context: Course 4-A supplies the Punisher and presents target lines suited to its penetration.

steps.text: Start course 4-A at the Chapter 14 range, wait until five sailor targets overlap in one straight line, and fire one Punisher round through all five.

achievements.description: Defeat El Gigante in Separate Ways.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{El Gigante} in Separate Ways Chapter 3.

guide.context: The fight is mandatory and can be completed on any difficulty.

steps.text: Attack the exposed Plaga after staggering El Gigante and finish the Chapter 3 boss battle.

achievements.description: Defeat Pesanta in Separate Ways.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Pesanta} in Separate Ways Chapter 5.

guide.context: This is the final mandatory Pesanta encounter, separate from the earlier village pursuit.

steps.text: Complete both phases of the Chapter 5 Pesanta fight until the boss dies.

achievements.description: Defeat Osmund Saddler in Separate Ways.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Osmund Saddler} in Separate Ways Chapter 7.

guide.context: Pillars block several tendril attacks, and the eye-stab prompt deals heavy damage after a stagger.

steps.text: Keep distance, attack with high-damage weapons such as the Blast Crossbow, use pillars as cover, and take each melee prompt to stab Saddler’s eye until the final boss dies.

achievements.description: Complete Separate Ways on Standard mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete Separate Ways on @mechanic{Standard difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: A Professional clear stacks the Standard and Hardcore completion achievements.

steps.text: Finish all seven Separate Ways chapters on Standard, Hardcore, or Professional.

achievements.description: Complete Separate Ways on Hardcore mode or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete Separate Ways on @mechanic{Hardcore difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Professional completion awards this simultaneously.

steps.text: Finish all seven Separate Ways chapters on Hardcore or Professional.

achievements.description: Complete Separate Ways on Professional mode.
achievements.summary: Complete Separate Ways on @mechanic{Professional difficulty}.

guide.context: Professional becomes selectable after one Separate Ways completion; an S+ clear also awards this ordinary completion result.

steps.text: Finish all seven Separate Ways chapters on Professional, with either a standard clear or the S+ route.

achievements.description: Complete Separate Ways on Professional mode with an S+ rank.
achievements.summary: Finish a fresh Separate Ways @mechanic{Professional New Game} under @mechanic{2:30} with no more than @mechanic{10 saves}.

guide.context: New Game+ is forbidden, but bonus weapons are allowed. Reloading a checkpoint retains failed time unless the game is exited to the main menu first.

steps.text: Unlock Professional and the Chicago Sweeper on earlier clears, then start a fresh Professional New Game; upgrade TMP damage first and obtain infinite ammo for the Sweeper with the 25-Spinel Exclusive Upgrade Ticket by Chapter 4.
Use saves around village Pesanta, the factory chainsaws, El Gigante, Castle drill, start of Chapter 5, final Pesanta, mines Merchant, start of Chapter 6, after the gondola, and before Saddler.
Arrive at Saddler by roughly 2:15, purchase a Rocket Launcher to end the fight quickly, and clear the finale before 2:30; after a death, return to the main menu before loading.
